skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply statistical analysis methods for forecasting in economics, management, and business administration.
Analyze time series data and build appropriate forecasting models.
Apply various forecasting techniques based on time series data.
Use econometric models with time series data for forecasting.
Construct and evaluate vector autoregression models.
Utilize statistical software (Eviews) for data analysis and forecasting.
Develop critical thinking in choosing topics and solving economic, management, and business administration problems.
Collect data for statistical analysis and forecasting.
Evaluate statistical models and forecasting results.
Solve problems using statistical methods and forecasting techniques.
